notes.title: Introducing Talespinner
notes.notes:
[p]Talespinner puts you right into the bizarre world of Japanese mythology, where you forge your own path and unravel a story of your own design.  Every story needs a hero. Select from 3 unique characters, each with distinct gameplay mechanics and a powerful set of cards that can be upgraded as you play. Forge powerful card synergies to dominate the narrative.  


Watch the trailer here 👇 [/p][previewyoutube="UlmRNe885mo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]Decide what adventure your hero will embark on. Are they being pursued by a ninja clan led by the famous Hanzo Hattori? Or perhaps they venture into the mountains to track down the Ice Lady, Yuki Onna, who haunts the local population there?

Every scenario offers additional story twists, adding layers of challenge and replayability.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825287/81c70502c70d700e31da468610d284fab9efc299.png"][/img]Take an epic journey through various biomes like bamboo forests, mysterious caves, windy plains, haunted villages, temples, and many more. Each biome offers diverse events, as well as a unique set of enemies, the Yokai.

Yokai come from a world of creatures & ghosts in Japanese mythology. Each Yokai comes with its own diverse set of skills, making every encounter a unique challenge. How to deal with them is up to you. Crush them in decisive combat or make them your allies through charm and cunning.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825287/9b6b75ba3c56df1d3ed7627f8eca4a49aa310240.png"][/img]As you progress, each battle rewards you with cards to add to your deck, allowing you to construct a deck that matches your playstyle. Each hero has a pool of unique cards, mechanics & events that make sure every runthrough is unique.

Victories can also reward you with a menagerie of companions such as a cute dog, the skull of a fallen samurai, or even a radish! They affect the way you play, opening up even more options to show off your tactical genius! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725410/Talespinner/"][/dynamiclink]Get ready to guide your hero through your chosen story and wishlist Talespinner today! Don't forget to join our Discord, and follow us on social media by clicking the buttons below.

We are also excited to announce that we will be working alongside UK-based publisher Kwalee to release Talespinner!

[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825287/d6876f12e18f28301f7135353581762ebae2d127.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Talespinner Has Been Selected for Turn-Based Thursday Fest!
notes.notes:
[h3]Every great warrior must have patience and recognise precisely when to strike…

Which is a fancy way of saying that, even in combat, sometimes you just need to wait for your turn.

We’re thrilled to announce that Talespinner has been selected to feature in Turn-Based Thursday Fest![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825287/d4565e358550e5da0c7a763a13306fa4484dc5ad.png[/img]

#TurnBasedThursdayFest is a seven-day online festival celebrating turn-based video games.

Talespinner is a roguelike deckbuilder that has been delicately hand-drawn to resemble traditional Japanese paintings and features multiple creatures torn straight from Japanese mythology. With its strategic turn-based combat, it was a natural fit for an event like this!
